pr_title: Feature/4404 add drag and drop to example
pr_body:
# Objective
Add DragAndDropFile::Dropped scene load functionality to scene_viewer example. Fixes #4404
pr_comments: Can you edit this to say either "Fixes #4404" or "Closes #4404"? That'll link the PR to the issue and automatically close it when the PR is merged :)

> You should also handle despawning the previous scene.
>

issue_context.title: Handle DroppedFile event in scene_viewer example
issue_context.body:
> Nice! One thing that would make this viewer more useful is handling the [DroppedFile](https://docs.rs/bevy/latest/bevy/prelude/enum.FileDragAndDrop.html#variant.DroppedFile) event.

- @HackerFoo in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/4403#issuecomment-1086932768

This would allow us to drag and drop model files onto the Bevy window to preview them in the scene viewer :)
comments: I've made the changes on a branch, awaiting #3772 to be merged so I can say for sure that this works

review_comments:
You can just use a ResMut here, which is clearer :)

I *think* the other incident of this can be changed to match; if you can get that to work please change it in this PR too.

I could, but at least in theory this system should work regardless of whether that resource already exists, so I think this approach makes sense logically, and there's no reason to use Option<ResMut<_>> because we don't care whether or not it already exists or what's in it
